keyword_cluster: pre-medical result / pre-engineering result / science general result / humanities result (Karachi)
intent: Group result - Sindh, genuinely separate event
notes: STRONGEST GROUP CASE IN THE MARKET. Different date, different gazette, different artifact. Incumbents are document uploads, social posts and raw PDFs - no national aggregator ranks at all. This is NOT cannibalization of the Punjab group pages; it is a different event model.

notes: Distinct task: readers want a FILE to search, not a page to read - the HTML wrapper ranks and the PDF is the payload. Boards publish deep archives (HSSC Part-I and Part-II 2012-2025 on one board, ~2014-2025 on another) yet rank only on archival phrasing. Current-year gazette queries for a major Punjab board and for the federal board returned mostly 9th/10th/11th material, NOT 12th. The board x class x year matrix is the opportunity.
A genuinely separate archival intent, and the ONE gazette surface where official board domains do rank. Hosting any file ourselves requires a rights and provenance review first.
